_doc: Showcase chains for scripts/demo/run.py. Boxes are fractions of the image [x0, y0, x1, y1]. A step is one edit on the current head unless it says from: <step name> (a branch). 'ref' on a box is an item image: 'gen:<prompt>' generates it first (1K, white background), or '@<step name>' uses that step's image.

tide_room.title: The Room Where the Tide Comes In
tide_room.start: A quiet 1970s living room at golden hour, photographed on Kodak Portra 400: low walnut sideboard, a mustard velvet armchair, a cream shag rug, a tall window with sheer linen curtains glowing with late sun, a single fern in a terracotta pot, dust motes floating in the warm light, soft film grain, still and nostalgic

steps.name: water
steps.edit: Flood the floor with perfectly still, clear seawater about knee-deep, the rug, chair legs and sideboard base submerged, golden window light reflecting and rippling on the water surface and caustics dancing across the walls; everything above the waterline stays exactly the same

regions.label: a single translucent moon jellyfish floating in the air like a lantern, glowing faint pink from within, long silk-thin tentacles drifting down toward the water
a small folded paper boat made from an old handwritten letter, floating on the water with a lit tea-light candle inside it and a soft warm reflection beneath
the view through the window becomes a vast calm ocean at dusk with an enormous pale pink moon sitting on the horizon, the curtains still glowing
a slow school of tiny silver fish swimming through the air in a loose spiral, catching the golden light
the potted fern becomes soft coral and sea anemones in pastel pink and cream growing from the pot, gently swaying

steps.name: night
steps.edit: Turn the whole scene into deep blue night: the moon is the only strong light, the jellyfish and the candle glow brighter, bioluminescent cyan sparkles where the water touches the furniture; keep every object exactly where it is

steps.name: painting
steps.edit: Repaint the entire image as a soft gouache illustration in the style of a 1960s children's picture book, flat pastel colors, visible paper texture and brush strokes, same composition and every object kept

porcelain.title: Porcelain Portrait
porcelain.start: Fine-art studio portrait of a young woman with a sleek black bob and calm closed eyes, wearing a high-collared ivory silk blouse, against a seamless dusty-rose backdrop, soft north-window light from the left, shot on medium format, shallow depth of field, serene and minimal

regions.label: her face and neck become glazed white porcelain with fine delicate kintsugi cracks filled with glowing gold, still clearly the same face, same closed eyes and expression
pale pink cherry blossom branches growing out of her hair like a crown, a few petals drifting
three luminous blue morpho butterflies made of stained glass, one resting on her shoulder
her hand raised gently holding a small floating sphere of water with a tiny goldfish inside
her eyes open, irises a pale luminous gold, gaze straight into the camera

steps.name: underwater
steps.edit: Place her deep underwater in a sunlit turquoise sea: light rays from above, her hair and the blossoms floating weightlessly, tiny bubbles rising, the porcelain and gold still exactly the same

steps.name: fresco
steps.edit: Turn the whole image into a faded Renaissance fresco painted on a cracked plaster wall, soft ochre and lapis tones, gold leaf halo behind her head, same pose and every detail kept

cloud_atelier.title: The Cloud Tailor
cloud_atelier.start: Editorial fashion photograph of a tall model with a shaved head standing on a rooftop at sunrise, wearing a simple oversized white t-shirt and wide grey trousers, barefoot, pastel lavender and peach sky full of soft clouds behind, shot on 35mm film, airy and calm

regions.label: replace the t-shirt with a voluminous sculptural coat made entirely of real soft cumulus clouds, catching peach sunrise light on its folds
glossy chrome platform boots reflecting the sky
the trousers become flowing pleated silk the color of the sunrise sky, a gradient from lavender to peach
a flock of white origami paper cranes flying out of the coat's collar into the sky

steps.name: storm
steps.edit: Change the weather to a dramatic violet thunderstorm at dusk, lightning in the distance, the cloud coat turns dark and electric with tiny flickers of lightning inside it; keep the model, pose and face exactly the same

steps.name: mars
steps.edit: Move the model onto the rust-red dunes of Mars under a pale butterscotch sky with two small moons, the cloud coat, silk trousers and chrome boots kept exactly

still_life.title: Impossible Still Life
still_life.start: Dutch Golden Age still life oil painting: a dark wooden table with a white linen cloth, a silver ewer, a halved lemon with its peel spiraling down, green grapes, a pewter plate with oysters, a tulip in a glass vase, deep black background, single dramatic window light from the left, rich glazes and fine craquelure

regions.label: the halved lemon becomes a tiny glowing planet Saturn with its rings resting on the cloth, painted in the same oil technique
the tulip turns into a delicate flame of liquid glass in rainbow colors, still standing in the vase
the silver ewer melts slowly like a Dali clock, dripping over the table edge
a small snail with a shell made of a tiny cathedral window in stained glass, crawling across the linen
a single pearl rolled out of an oyster, glowing like a small moon

steps.name: neon
steps.edit: Change the lighting to a single magenta and cyan neon light from the left, as if the painting were lit in a nightclub, everything else kept exactly the same

steps.name: photo
steps.edit: Turn the whole painting into a crisp modern studio photograph of the same real objects, same arrangement, same dramatic light

loft_drop.title: Drop It In: furnishing with item images
loft_drop.start: Wide photograph of an empty industrial loft: raw concrete walls with faint water stains, polished concrete floor, tall black steel-framed windows on the left letting in soft overcast daylight, nothing in the room, 35mm lens at eye level, editorial interior photography

regions.label: place this sofa on the floor
regions.ref: gen:Studio product photo of a mid-century cognac leather three-seat sofa with tufted cushions and thin walnut legs, three-quarter view, isolated on a pure white seamless background

regions.label: place this floor lamp standing on the floor, switched on with a warm glow
regions.ref: gen:Studio product photo of a tall sculptural floor lamp with a brass stem and a large pleated paper shade, isolated on a pure white background

regions.label: lay this rug flat on the floor in front of the sofa, in perspective
regions.ref: gen:Top-down product photo of a hand-knotted wool rug with a bold abstract pattern of rust, cream and forest green arcs, isolated on white

regions.label: hang this framed artwork on the wall above the sofa
regions.ref: gen:Product photo of a large framed abstract painting with soft pastel blobs of peach, lilac and olive on raw canvas, thin oak frame, front view, white background

regions.label: place this potted plant on the floor
regions.ref: gen:Product photo of a tall fiddle leaf fig tree in a matte white ceramic planter, isolated on white

steps.name: dusk
steps.edit: Make it blue-hour dusk outside the windows, city lights coming on, the floor lamp now the main warm light in the room, everything else kept exactly
